Ilaf One · card designs

Card faces, layouts and animations

Every design here is its own hand-built layout. Colours are not picked from a big palette: each face comes with the colourways made for it, and the area below the card and its icons use the same colours so everything matches. Everything starts with sample data, so an owner sees a finished card before choosing anything, then changes what they like.
